data.title: Open the beta to testers this Friday?
body: Every fix has passed review, and the notes for testers are written.
data.recommendation: Yes. Waiting a week adds nothing we know of.

asks.q: Will testers see my own data?
asks.a: No. The beta starts empty; your data stays on your phone.

data.title: Stop build 1.1 for testers? It crashes when a saved list is opened.
body: Three testers hit it this morning. Build 1.2 has the fix and waits for your upload (№ 13).
data.recommendation: Stop it now. Testers keep their lists, and they get 1.2 as soon as it's uploaded.

data.title: Upload build 1.2 to the beta
body: Only you can do this: it needs your developer account.
steps: Open the developer site and sign in.
Pick build 1.2 and add it to the testers' group.
Paste the notes below into “What to test”.

copies.label: What to test
copies.text: Search now finds recipes by ingredient. Try a search with two ingredients, and tell us if anything is missing.

data.title: Keep the free plan at three saved lists?
data.recommendation: Keep three. Raising it later is easy; lowering it isn't.

data.title: Charge for sync between devices, after version 2?
body: Two testers asked for it. Nothing waits on this until version 2.
data.recommendation: Decide after the beta, with the testers' numbers.

data.title: Use the new app icon?
data.outcome: The builder switched to the new icon; it's in build 1.2.

data.title: Sign in to the test account on the second phone
steps: Open Settings on the second phone.
Sign in with the test account.
data.outcome: Both test phones now sync; the reviewer passed the sync test.
